name: Event
description: Incidents and changes that alter the current situation

fields.description: Green flames spring up spontaneously on nearby surfaces and lean toward the same distant direction for one minute.
A terrified courier mistakes someone present for a contact, delivers a sealed confession from a powerful figure, and flees.
A compact raincloud follows one person while the sky remains clear a few steps away.
Two merchants abruptly begin bidding against each other for the item known as {{ loot.generator.name }} and refuse to explain its value.
A wounded predator bursts into view, fleeing something much more dangerous that remains out of sight.
Until sunset, every deliberate spoken lie releases a curl of black smoke visible to everyone nearby.
Strangers abruptly begin a celebration centered on a wildly distorted version of a recent deed by someone present.
A patch of ground gives way, revealing an old stairway that descends toward a place described as {{ site:dungeon.generator.name }} while making the surrounding route dangerous.
A child asks for help with a haunting, but the apparition insists that the child is the true intruder.
Tiny harmless frogs rain from a cloudless sky, each bearing the same golden rune of {{ rules.name }}.
Fresh wanted posters appear, dated tomorrow and accusing the party of involvement in {{ crime.name }}, which has not happened yet.
A nearby statue turns its head and quietly warns the least observant onlooker of immediate danger.
A band of travelers offers safe passage, but every member insists they have known the same person present for years.
For one hour, shadows detach from their owners and act out intentions their owners have not admitted.
A nearby bridge, tunnel, or causeway collapses, dividing those present and cutting off the easiest way back.
A magical market unfolds in an ordinary open space and will vanish after exactly thirteen purchases.
A dying messenger bird delivers a signet ring and repeats the name of a place absent from every map.
An eclipse begins years ahead of every prediction, and magic associated with {{ rules.name }} produces reversed or symbolic effects.
A formal procession representing {{ faction.name }} enters the area just as masked attackers exploit the crowd and confusion to strike.
Nearby flowing water reverses direction, exposing something long submerged and stirring what rested beside it.
A celebrated adventurer publicly credits someone present for a deed they never performed and asks them to maintain the story.
Nearly everyone in the immediate area falls asleep at once, leaving awake only a wary stranger with the {{ background.generator.name }} background.
A wandering judge convenes an immediate trial over ownership of the unusual item known as {{ loot:curio.generator.name }} and demands witnesses from those present.
A harmless animal begins speaking with the voice of an absent acquaintance and asks for urgent help.
The moon briefly reveals a second face, after which every compass nearby points toward the same person.
A battlefield from the distant past overlays the present surroundings, and ghostly actions cause real damage.
A thief steals something trivial nearby but leaves the valuable item known as {{ loot:valuables.generator.name }}, which is dangerously recognizable.
A bell rings beneath the ground while nearby residents deny that it exists and urgently seek shelter.
Envoys from {{ faction.name }} and {{ faction.name }} unexpectedly request neutral witnesses for immediate peace talks.
Time lurches forward by three hours; evidence shows that consequential events occurred during the gap, but memories conflict.
The ground shakes hard enough to interrupt events and reveal a fissure or weakened structure.
Cries draw nearer as wildlife flees an unseen creature of the {{ monster.name }} type.
A voice calls for help from a place where nobody should be able to survive.
An unusual stench fills the area, leading toward its source while warning of danger.
A pleasant scent subtly alters the attention, emotions, or behavior of those exposed.
Several people feel the same pain at once without visible injury.
Someone nearby loses consciousness moments after trying to warn others about an unclear danger.
The weather changes abruptly, complicating travel, combat, or communication.
A newcomer with the {{ background.generator.name }} background appears and claims to have known one of the people present for years.
Several creatures of the {{ monster.name }} type enter the area after a greater threat drives them from their territory.
Night falls or day breaks hours too early, while clocks and memories disagree.
A written message arrives from another time and contains details only its present recipient should know.
Someone’s history returns in the form of a witness, debt, possession, or accusation.
Several nearby people suddenly show signs of the affliction known as {{ affliction.name }}.
Essential food, water, or medicine suddenly disappears, spoils, or becomes unusable.
Abnormal heat or cold forces everyone to seek shelter or an explanation quickly.
For several minutes, gravity pulls sideways and sends unsecured people and objects sliding toward the same direction.
All sound vanishes from the area, preventing speech and masking every approaching danger.
Several nearby people simultaneously remember the same vivid event, though none of them lived it.
A familiar landmark visible moments ago vanishes, leaving altered terrain and contradictory recollections behind.
All active magic associated with {{ rules.name }} goes dark or dormant at once while ordinary light and machinery continue to work.
A perfect duplicate of the item known as {{ loot.generator.name }} appears beside it, including marks no observer had noticed on the original.
A weary group arrives seeking immediate shelter from a danger its members cannot clearly describe.
An ordinary door, arch, or narrow gap suddenly opens onto the impossibly distant place described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
A brilliant object made of {{ material.name }} crosses the sky and strikes close enough to shake the area and draw immediate attention.
A dropped dossier bursts open in front of gathering witnesses, exposing evidence that someone nearby may be connected to {{ crime.name }}.
A breathless agent offers immediate payment to anyone who can carry out work involving {{ service.name }}, but insists it must begin at once and remain discreet.
For one hour, nobody in the area can remember or recognize proper names, titles, or written signatures.
